name: MOV
syntax: MOV hedef, kaynak | MOV dest, src
description: Copies the source value into the destination. Memory-to-memory moves and loading a constant into a segment register are not allowed.
example:
mov ax, 1234h
mov [bx], al
mov ds, ax

name: XCHG
description: Exchanges the values of the two operands.

name: PUSH
description: SP is decreased by 2 and the value is stored at SS:SP (top of the stack).

name: POP
description: The word at SS:SP is loaded into the destination and SP is increased by 2.

name: PUSHF / POPF
description: Pushes the FLAGS register onto the stack / pops it back.

name: PUSHA / POPA
description: (80186) Pushes / pops all general registers (AX, CX, DX, BX, SP, BP, SI, DI).

name: LEA
description: Loads the effective address (offset) of a memory operand into a register; memory is not read.

name: LDS / LES
syntax: LDS reg16, bellek | LES reg16, bellek
description: Reads a 32-bit far pointer: the offset goes into the register, the segment into DS (LDS) or ES (LES).

name: LAHF / SAHF
description: Copies the low byte of FLAGS into AH (LAHF) or loads it from AH (SAHF).
flags: SAHF: SF ZF AF PF CF

name: XLAT
description: AL = [DS:BX + AL]. Used to translate a value through a table.
example:
lea bx, table
mov al, 3
xlat

name: IN / OUT
syntax: IN AL|AX, port | OUT port, AL|AX (port: sabit 0-255 veya DX)
description: Reads from (IN) or writes to (OUT) an I/O port. The virtual devices use these ports.
example:
in al, 125
mov dx, 3F8h
out dx, al

name: CBW / CWD
description: Sign-extends: CBW turns AL into AX, CWD turns AX into DX:AX.

name: ADD
description: dest = dest + src.
flags: OF SF ZF AF PF CF
example:
add ax, bx
add byte ptr [si], 5

name: ADC
description: dest = dest + src + CF. Carries between words in multi-word additions.
flags: OF SF ZF AF PF CF
example:
add ax, cx
adc dx, bx   ; 32 bit toplama

name: SUB
description: dest = dest - src.
flags: OF SF ZF AF PF CF

name: SBB
description: dest = dest - src - CF.
flags: OF SF ZF AF PF CF

name: CMP
description: Computes op1 - op2 without storing the result; only the flags change. Usually followed by a conditional jump.
flags: OF SF ZF AF PF CF

name: INC / DEC
description: Adds / subtracts 1. CF is not affected.
flags: OF SF ZF AF PF (CF değişmez / unchanged)

name: NEG
description: Two's complement: dest = 0 - dest.
flags: OF SF ZF AF PF CF

name: MUL
description: Unsigned multiply. 8-bit: AX = AL × src. 16-bit: DX:AX = AX × src.
example:
mov al, 12
mov bl, 10
mul bl   ; AX = 120

name: IMUL
syntax: IMUL kaynak | IMUL reg16, r/m, sabit (80186)
description: Signed multiply; uses the same registers as MUL.

name: DIV
description: Unsigned divide. 8-bit: AL = AX / src, AH = remainder. 16-bit: AX = DX:AX / src, DX = remainder. Division by zero or overflow raises a divide error.
example:
mov ax, 100
mov bl, 7
div bl   ; AL=14, AH=2

name: IDIV
description: Signed divide; uses the same registers as DIV.

name: DAA / DAS
description: Adjusts AL after packed BCD addition / subtraction.

name: AAA / AAS / AAM / AAD
description: Adjustments for unpacked (ASCII) BCD arithmetic. AAM splits AL into two decimal digits.

name: AND
description: Bitwise AND. Used to clear (mask) bits.

name: OR
description: Bitwise OR. Used to set bits.

name: XOR
description: Bitwise exclusive OR. Used to toggle bits or zero a register.

name: NOT
description: Inverts every bit (one's complement).

name: TEST
description: Performs AND without storing the result; only the flags change.

name: SHL / SAL
description: Shifts bits left; the bit shifted out goes to CF. Each shift multiplies by 2.

name: SHR
description: Shifts bits right, filling with 0 (unsigned divide by 2).

name: SAR
description: Shifts right keeping the sign bit (signed divide by 2).

name: ROL / ROR
syntax: ROL hedef, sayı | ROR hedef, sayı
description: Rotates bits; the bit leaving one end enters at the other.

name: RCL / RCR
syntax: RCL hedef, sayı | RCR hedef, sayı
description: Rotates through the carry flag (dest and CF rotate together).

name: JMP
description: Unconditional jump. Encoded short (2 bytes) or near (3 bytes).

name: JE / JZ, JNE / JNZ
description: Jumps if ZF=1 (equal / zero); JNE jumps if ZF=0.

name: JA JAE JB JBE
description: After an unsigned compare: A=above (CF=0,ZF=0), AE=above or equal (CF=0), B=below (CF=1), BE=below or equal.

name: JG JGE JL JLE
description: After a signed compare: G=greater, GE=greater or equal, L=less (SF≠OF), LE=less or equal.

name: JC JNC JO JNO JS JNS JP JNP
description: Jumps on a single flag: C=carry, O=overflow, S=sign, P=parity (N = when the flag is 0).

name: JCXZ
description: Jumps if CX = 0.

name: LOOP
description: Decrements CX and jumps if CX ≠ 0. Used for counted loops.

name: LOOPE / LOOPNE
description: Like LOOP, but also requires ZF=1 (LOOPE) or ZF=0 (LOOPNE).

name: CALL
description: Pushes the return address (IP) and jumps to the procedure.

name: RET / RETF
description: Pops the return address and returns to the caller. With n, SP is increased by n (to drop parameters).

name: INT
description: Software interrupt: pushes FLAGS, CS and IP and runs the service from the vector table. INT 10h video, INT 16h keyboard, INT 21h DOS.

name: IRET
description: Returns from an interrupt handler: pops IP, CS and FLAGS.

name: MOVSB / MOVSW
description: Copies [DS:SI] to [ES:DI]; SI and DI increase when DF=0, decrease when DF=1.

name: CMPSB / CMPSW
description: Compares [DS:SI] with [ES:DI].
flags: OF SF ZF AF PF CF

name: SCASB / SCASW
description: Compares AL/AX with [ES:DI]; used to search a string.
flags: OF SF ZF AF PF CF

name: LODSB / LODSW
description: Loads [DS:SI] into AL/AX and advances SI.

name: STOSB / STOSW
description: Stores AL/AX at [ES:DI] and advances DI.
example:
mov al, ' '
mov cx, 80
rep stosb

name: REP / REPE / REPNE
description: Repeats the following string instruction CX times (REPE: while equal, REPNE: while not equal).

name: CLC / STC / CMC
description: Clears, sets or complements the carry flag.

name: CLD / STD
description: Clears / sets the direction flag. After CLD string instructions move forward.

name: CLI / STI
description: Disables / enables hardware interrupts.

name: HLT
description: Halts the processor. In emu8086ln the program stops here.

name: NOP
description: Does nothing (1 byte).

name: INT 21h / AH=09h
description: DOS: prints text up to the '$' character.
example:
mov dx, offset msg
mov ah, 9
int 21h

name: INT 21h / AH=01h, 02h
syntax: AH=01h: tuş oku + ekrana yaz (AL) | AH=02h: DL karakterini yaz
description: DOS: read and print a single character.

name: INT 21h / AH=0Ah
description: DOS: reads a line until Enter. The second byte receives the character count.
example:
mov dx, offset buf
mov ah, 0Ah
int 21h

name: INT 21h / AH=4Ch
description: DOS: terminates the program.

name: INT 21h / AH=3Ch..42h
syntax: 3Ch oluştur, 3Dh aç, 3Eh kapat, 3Fh oku, 40h yaz, 41h sil, 42h konum
description: DOS file functions on the virtual drive C: (Documents\emu8086ln\vdrive\C). On error CF=1 and AX holds the error code.
example:
mov ah, 3Dh
mov al, 0
mov dx, offset name
int 21h

name: INT 10h / AH=00h
description: BIOS: sets the video mode and clears the screen.

name: INT 10h / AH=02h
syntax: DH = satır, DL = sütun, BH = sayfa
description: BIOS: moves the cursor.
example:
mov dh, 5
mov dl, 10
mov ah, 2
int 10h

name: INT 10h / AH=09h, 0Eh
syntax: 09h: AL karakter, BL renk, CX tekrar | 0Eh: AL karakter (daktilo)
description: BIOS: write a coloured character (09h) or teletype output (0Eh).
example:
mov al, '*'
mov bl, 0Ch
mov cx, 1
mov ah, 9
int 10h

name: INT 10h / AH=0Ch
syntax: AL = renk, CX = x, DX = y
description: BIOS: plots a pixel in graphics mode.
example:
mov ax, 0C0Fh
mov cx, 100
mov dx, 50
int 10h

name: INT 16h / AH=00h, 01h
syntax: 00h: tuş bekle (AH tarama kodu, AL ASCII) | 01h: tuş var mı (ZF)
description: BIOS keyboard: wait for a key, or check for a pending key.

name: INT 15h / AH=86h
description: BIOS: waits for the given time (for animations).
example:
mov cx, 0Fh
mov dx, 4240h
mov ah, 86h
int 15h

name: ORG
description: Sets the location counter. COM programs start at 100h.

name: DB / DW / DD
description: Defines bytes (DB), words (DW) or double words (DD). ? means no initial value.
example:
msg db 'Merhaba$'
sayilar dw 1, 2, 3
tampon db 20 dup(?)

name: EQU
description: Defines a constant; uses no memory. $ is the current address.

name: PROC / ENDP
description: Defines a procedure called with CALL and left with RET.
example:
topla proc
  add ax, bx
  ret
topla endp

name: SEGMENT / ENDS
description: Defines a segment in EXE programs; code, data and stack live in separate segments.

name: MACRO / ENDM
description: Defines a macro expanded in place where it is used. LOCAL creates labels private to each expansion.
example:
yaz macro c
  mov dl, c
  mov ah, 2
  int 21h
endm

name: INCLUDE
description: Inserts another file here. emu8086.inc provides ready macros such as PRINT, PRINTN, PUTC, GOTOXY, SCAN_NUM and PRINT_NUM.

name: #make_COM# / #make_EXE#
description: Selects the output file type (emu8086 compatible). #start=device.exe# opens a virtual device panel.

name: BYTE PTR / WORD PTR
description: Tells whether an otherwise ambiguous memory operand is 8 or 16 bits.

name: OFFSET / SEG
description: Gives the offset (address inside its segment) or the segment of a label.
example:
mov dx, offset msg
mov ax, seg msg

name: AX (AH, AL)
description: Accumulator: used by arithmetic, MUL/DIV, IN/OUT and most interrupt services. AH and AL are its 8-bit halves.

name: BX (BH, BL)
description: Base register: can address memory as [BX].
example:
mov bx, offset table
mov al, [bx]

name: CX (CH, CL)
description: Counter: used by LOOP, REP and as the shift count (CL).

name: DX (DH, DL)
description: Data register: high word of 16-bit MUL/DIV, port number for IN/OUT DX, DOS string addresses.
example:
mov dx, offset msg
mov ah, 9
int 21h

name: SI
description: Source index: source of string instructions (DS:SI) and memory addressing.

name: DI
description: Destination index: destination of string instructions (ES:DI) and memory addressing.

name: BP
description: Base pointer: accesses stack parameters and locals as [BP+n] (SS segment).
example:
push bp
mov bp, sp
mov ax, [bp+4]

name: SP
description: Stack pointer: top of the stack (SS:SP). PUSH decreases it, POP increases it.

name: CS
description: Code segment: instructions are fetched from CS:IP.

name: DS
description: Data segment: most memory accesses use DS.
example:
mov ax, data
mov ds, ax

name: ES
description: Extra segment: destination of string instructions (ES:DI) and extra data.

name: SS
description: Stack segment: PUSH/POP/CALL/RET work on SS:SP.
example:
mov ax, stack
mov ss, ax
